A tidy-up of the whole panel after the UI audit: display fixes, one consistent layout, a proper phone layout, and a System page split into sections. Nothing about how servers run has changed.

### Highlights

- **Phones.** Server cards fit the screen. The server header keeps the name readable and puts Start, Restart and Stop in a **Power** menu. On smaller screens the ten server tabs become a menu showing the current tab, instead of a strip that scrolls sideways.
- **System is now five pages:** Overview, Updates, Off-site storage, Notifications, and Account and security. Links in notifications take you straight to the right one.
- **Unsaved changes.** Settings and Game settings show a **Discard** and **Save** bar at the bottom while you have unsaved changes, and every field has a short description.
- **Export world** has moved from Backups to the World tab.
- **One layout everywhere.** Pages share one width, card headings and toolbar buttons match, option cards are equal columns, and disabled buttons turn grey.
- **Release notes** like these are now shown formatted in the panel, through a small reader that only allows safe links.
- **Dates and times** follow your own locale everywhere.

### Fixes

- The Console **Address** card shows the server's hostname, matching the header.
- The notice for content that isn't installed names the items in a readable sentence.
- The Snapshots switch on **New server** no longer turns red when versions fail to load.
- Paper is described as "runs plugins".

### Testing

The checklist is under **UI pass** in [testing-1.1.0.md](https://github.com/MattA-Official/mc-panel/blob/v1.1.0-beta.3/docs/testing-1.1.0.md).
